description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for user management, including CRUD operations, user registration, profile updates, password changes, and deletion, with dependencies on database sessions, security, and email utilities.

methods.name: read_users
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users with pagination, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Create a new user and optionally send a welcome email, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: update_user_me
methods.description: Update the current user's profile information.

methods.name: update_password_me
methods.description: Change the current user's password after verifying the current password.

methods.name: read_user_me
methods.description: Get the profile information of the current user.

methods.name: delete_user_me
methods.description: Delete the current user's account unless they are a superuser.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Register a new user without authentication.

methods.name: read_user_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their UUID, with access control based on superuser status.

methods.name: update_user
methods.description: Update user details by ID, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: delete_user
methods.description: Delete a user by ID and remove their items, accessible only to superusers.
